ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping Districts; B3-3, Community Shopping Districts; and C2-2, Motor
Vehicle-Related Commercial Districts symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
18-C in the area bound by:

South Stony Island Avenue; a line 150 feet south of and parallel to East 71%
Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Stony Island Avenue; the alley
next south of and parallel to East 71" Street; South Cornell Avenue; a line 125
feet south of and parallel to East 71* Street; the alley next east of and parallel to
South Cornell Avenue; a line 75 feet south of and parallel to East 71* Street;
South East End Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to East 71* Street;
the alley next east of and parallel to South Ridgeland Avenue; a line 167.06 feet
south of and parallel to East 71* Street; a line 211 feet east of and parallel to
South Ridgeland Avenue; a line 177.98 feet north of and parallel to East 71*
Place; a line 134.45 feet west of and parallel to South Constance Avenue; a line
82 feet south of and parallel to East 71° Street; South Constance Avenue; and
East 71* Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
